meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 OpenCode 作为编码 agent,接入多家模型服务。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想让 OpenCode 充当编码 agent,且需要接入多家模型服务。
copy.tagline_en: Set up OpenCode as a coding agent to connect to multiple LLM providers.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to use OpenCode as your coding agent with multiple model backends.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把 OpenCode 集成进 NanoClaw:补文件、装依赖、重建镜像。组 provider 设为 opencode 后,agent 走 OpenCode 配置调 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等模型。
howto.when: 当用户要求把 OpenCode 加为 NanoClaw 的 agent provider 时触发。前置检查通过就跳过安装直接配置;不通过则执行复制、依赖、构建等完整安装步骤。

say.text: 给这个项目加上 OpenCode 作为 agent provider
say.note: 会执行文件复制、依赖安装并重建镜像。

say.text: 把 <组ID> 组的 provider 设为 opencode 并重启
say.note: 对应组会重启并改用 opencode 后端。

say.text: 配 DeepSeek 的 OPENCODE_PROVIDER 并注册密钥
say.note: 会写入典型 env 并调用 onecli 注册密钥。

howto.what_en: NanoClaw gains an opencode backend alongside default claude. Setting a group's provider to opencode routes agents through OpenCode config (OpenRouter, DeepSeek, etc.) instead of the Anthropic Agent SDK; deps added, image rebuilt.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add OpenCode support in the NanoClaw repo. If pre-flight files are already present, it skips to configuration; otherwise it runs the full install.

say_en.text: Add OpenCode as an agent provider for this project.
say_en.note: Runs install: copies files, adds deps, rebuilds image.

say_en.text: Switch group <ID> to the opencode provider and restart it.
say_en.note: The group restarts and agents use the OpenCode backend.

say_en.text: Set up DeepSeek: configure OPENCODE_PROVIDER and register the API key.
say_en.note: Writes typical env and calls onecli to register the secret.
